added: While you set up a review, the last step now lets you add the passage for participants (a file up to 50 MB, a link such as a sign-language video, or just the passage name). It is optional: choose "Skip for now" and add passages later under Prepare. (#440)
changed: The app's hashing and signing helpers now live in one place; links, codes and receipts are signed exactly as before. (#435)
The Home "Sign in" button picks its destination directly from the email-links setting instead of rewriting the page text afterwards; where it leads is unchanged. (#436)
On a print preview in another language, a screen reader now hears the "no shared link" box in that language (or is told it is English when no translation exists). (#436)

No behaviour change: a test now pins that a refused passage link (the "a link must be a full https:// address" message) stays typed in the link fields and that message shows as the status line. (#437)
fixed: While results are held, the Results line no longer says "at least three responses per group"; it now says how many responses are in and how many the server needs (for example 3 so far, at least 5 needed), or a plain line when those numbers are not given. (#438)
When an assessment cannot be deleted, the message now names what is in the way (its surveys, its responses, or both) instead of saying "0 responses". (#439)
